device.description: 8-bit serial-control SAR ADC with 8-channel multiplexer (single-ended, pseudo-differential or differential) and shift-enable control
device.note: tlc0834.pdf (SLAS094E) p.1 pinouts, p.2 functional block diagram (Note A), p.3 functional description, p.4-5 sequence of operation and MUX-address control logic tables, p.6 TLC0838 MUX table, p.7 recommended operating conditions, p.8 operating characteristics (tpd, tdis, tc), p.9-10 Figures 1-3

registers.name: CTRL
registers.note: internal: the MUX address word after the start bit (no read-back; cleared when CS goes high per p.3, reset 0 here)

commands.name: Start bit + MUX address
commands.note: p.5-6: start bit, SGL/DIF, ODD/EVEN, SELECT 1, SELECT 0 on CLK rising edges (leading zeros ignored). Capture a = ODD/EVEN,SEL1,SEL0: 000 CH0, 001 CH2, 010 CH4, 011 CH6, 100 CH1, 101 CH3, 110 CH5, 111 CH7 (the + input; COM is the - input single-ended; differential pairs CH0/1, 2/3, 4/5, 6/7). Reply with SE low: the MUX-settling low, D7..D0 MSB first, then D1..D7 LSB first, then DO low until CS rises

commands.name: Leading zero (no start bit)
commands.note: p.3: the first logic high on DI is the start bit; leading zeros are ignored

pages: p.1 (pinouts), p.2 (block diagram), p.3 (functional description), p.5 (TLC0838 sequence, SE timing), p.6 (MUX table), p.7 (ROC), p.8 (tpd, tdis, tc), p.9-10 (Figures 1-3)
notModeled: analog inputs, multiplexer, single-ended / differential selection and REF span (stored only; the result is always the 0 V code 0x00)

DI is examined only during the MUX-addressing interval (p.3); the model's stream frame keeps matching DI, so a 1 on DI during the output restarts the reply. Hold DI low after the address; the DI/DO one-wire tie (p.3) is not supported
DO is high impedance from CS fall until the MUX-settling clock; the model shifts z for at most 32 leading clocks before a start bit
SARS: high while the conversion is in progress and high impedance while CS is high (p.3); with the clocked conversion (time 0) the model only drives it low
the conversion is clocked by CLK (tc = 8 clock periods after the MUX settling clock, p.8); not timed, the result is the 0 V code at once
f(clock) 10-600 kHz, 40-60 % duty cycle, tsu 350 ns, th 90 ns, CS high 220 ns min (p.7); tpd is 1500 ns max MSB-first and 600 ns LSB-first (the model uses 1500 ns for every bit)
tFloat uses tdis 500 ns (CL = 100 pF, RL = 2 kOhm); 250 ns at CL = 10 pF
all internal registers are cleared when CS goes high; a new conversion needs a CS high-to-low transition (p.3)
codeFormat: straight binary; when IN- is more positive than IN+ the output is 0000 0000 (p.7 Note 3)
SE (shift enable): the model always behaves as SE held low (LSB-first data follows the MSB-first data); with SE high the LSB is held on DO until SE falls, then D1..D7 are clocked out (p.3, p.5)
variants: TLC0834 (4 channels, no COM/SE) shares the datasheet; N, DW and PW packages share one pin numbering (p.1)
